Messages.Author: Ziphiid
Messages.Body:
I just got off the phone with a customer service representative from
Wizards of the Coast......He had a few things to say:

1) The card backs on all of the cards are going to change.

2)The borders are NOT going to change on the library cards...because the
different colors can be seen from the side of the deck (as with
MAGIC cards)
-instead, they are going to have black borders, but different
backgrounds (like the vampire clan cards)

more..............

Messages.Author: Ziphiid
Messages.Body:
3) The next printing of the game will be identical to the original
game....art and cards except for 4 cards (he did not know which ones) that
they were FIXING. He said that they do not change cards based on the
artwork..so they won't get rid of any of the gory stuff Yeah!!!

more.....

Messages.Author: Ziphiid
Messages.Body:
4)They are arranging an EXCHANGE system, where I can send in my current
cards, and they will trade 1-for-1 for the new cards. He didn't have any
details on when or how this would work as they are still working on it,
but they will post it on the net when available.

more....

Messages.Author: Ziphiid
Messages.Body:
Finally, I just wanted to say that this is extremely fair. The
representative did not know if they would charge a handling fee or not,
but if they exchange all my cards for the new ones, I will be very happy.
This eliminates all the cardback problems.

If you want to call customer service for yourself....206-624-0933

Once again a happy camper....BRYCE MILLER

Messages.Author: Karl J. Hiller
Messages.Body:
Thomas R Wylie (aa...@cats.ucsc.edu) wrote:
: Actually, it has not been decided yet whether there will be a card exchange

: program or not. However, I will certainly pass along any feedback on
: the question, which so far has been extremely positive.

Ye gods - the amount of time and effort, not to mention postage, required
to ship millions of cards back and forth...

With this many people owning old cards, does anyone believe that the
turnaround time for replacement will be less than, say, half a year?
Maybe more? Dark Sovereigns comes out in August - who's going to want to
ship their cards off to WoTC (where you, the customer, are "irrelevant")
until November or December and WAIT that long to play with the new cards?

I mean, what are they going to do - instruct everyone to make out a
detailed list of every card they're sending, and then have someone go
into the vault and hand-pick V:TES versions of all those cards?

If even an eighth of the Jyhad print run gets sent back for replacement,
that's 22.5 MILLION cards. Think about it. We're talking serious
man-hours just to process the replacements, not to mention the cost of
the cards themselves.

Not changing the backs, now, THAT would be simple.

Messages.Author: Jay Wagnon
Messages.Body:
Thomas R Wylie (aa...@cats.ucsc.edu) wrote:

: Actually, it has not been decided yet whether there will be a card exchange
: program or not. However, I will certainly pass along any feedback on
: the question, which so far has been extremely positive.

: Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for

: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.

Well then, please allow me to add my approval to the 'proposed'
card exchange. I know that this is the only way that I will continue to
invest in the Jyhad/V:TES game. I agree with the many outcries that
different card backs will influence this great game in an undesirable way.
As such, I can no longer justify spending my money to invest in expansions
that will not be completely (and I mean _completely_!!!) compatable with
my current investment (no matter how much I love this game...which is in
the extreme). A 1-for-1 trade of my soon-to-be-obselete cards for the
new, expansion-combatable cards would certainly remedy this unfortunate
feeling and allow me to fully commit myself to the expansions and,
therefore, the growth of the game in general (through new player
interaction, investing money in a company I believe in, etc.)

If you are counting votes in any way, please add mine to the
exchange approval list.

-- Jay Wagnon
